env.app: UNMAPPED_TEST_CLOCK_DAYS=92 OPENAI_API_KEY= THESYS_API_KEY= AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA=$SCR/localbeat/ud bun run dev --remoteDebuggingPort 9352

actions.eval: (async () => { const s = await import("/state/index.ts"); const w = s.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (w.status !== "ready") return w; const n = w.value.sequenced; return { head: n.head.n, rt: n.rt, season: n.season, beats: n.beats, marks: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(s.useLandStore.getState().marks).map(([k, m]) => [k, { live: m.live?.name ?? null, fogged: m.fogged, fading: m.fading, legends: m.legends?.length }])) } })()

(async () => { const s = await import("/state/index.ts"); const n = s.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value.sequenced; const c = n.chunks["2,1"]; return { ignored: n.ignored, care21: n.care["2,1"], care10: n.care["1,0"], genesisRt: n.genesisRt, fogged: c.fogged, liveId: c.live.id, legends: c.legends.length } })()
